sql: SELECT event, COUNT(*) AS alert_count, COUNT(DISTINCT office_id) AS office_count FROM alerts GROUP BY event HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY alert_count DESC, event
SELECT DISTINCT z.zone_code, z.zone_name FROM zones z JOIN alert_zones az ON az.zone_key = z.zone_key WHERE z.zone_type = 'county' AND z.state = 'AZ' ORDER BY z.zone_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offices WHERE state = 'AK'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE response = 'Execute'
SELECT DISTINCT message_type FROM alerts WHERE message_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY message_type
SELECT event, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN urgency = 'Immediate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct FROM alerts GROUP BY event HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY pct DESC, event

WITH c AS (SELECT o.region, o.office_id, o.office_name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON o.office_id = a.office_id GROUP BY o.region, o.office_id, o.office_name), r AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY n DESC) AS rk FROM c) SELECT region, office_id, office_name, n AS alert_count FROM r WHERE rk = 1 ORDER BY region, office_id

SELECT o.office_id, o.office_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON o.office_id = a.office_id WHERE a.max_wind_gust = '50 MPH' GROUP BY o.office_id, o.office_name ORDER BY o.office_id
SELECT event, COUNT(*) AS alert_count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(max_hail_size AS REAL)), 2) AS avg_hail FROM alerts WHERE max_hail_size IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event ORDER BY event
SELECT o.region, COUNT(DISTINCT a.event) AS event_count FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON o.office_id = a.office_id GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region

SELECT o.office_id, o.office_name, COUNT(DISTINCT az.zone_key) AS zone_count FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON o.office_id = a.office_id JOIN alert_zones az ON az.alert_id = a.alert_id GROUP BY o.office_id, o.office_name ORDER BY zone_count DESC, o.office_id

SELECT o.office_id, o.office_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.urgency = 'Immediate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.urgency), 2) AS immediate_pct FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON o.office_id = a.office_id WHERE a.urgency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.office_id, o.office_name HAVING COUNT(a.urgency) >= 2 ORDER BY immediate_pct DESC, o.office_id

SELECT o.region, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.severity = 'Severe' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.severity), 2) AS severe_pct FROM alerts a JOIN offices o ON o.office_id = a.office_id WHERE a.severity IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.region HAVING COUNT(a.severity) >= 3 ORDER BY severe_pct DESC, o.region

WITH d AS (SELECT office_id, alert_id, (julianday(expires) - julianday(sent)) * 24 * 60 AS dm FROM alerts WHERE julianday(expires) > julianday(sent)), r AS (SELECT office_id, alert_id, dm, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY office_id ORDER BY dm DESC) AS duration_rank FROM d) SELECT office_id, alert_id, ROUND(dm, 2) AS duration_minutes, duration_rank FROM r WHERE duration_rank = 1 ORDER BY office_id, alert_id
